title: We're Asking an Appeals Court to Require a Warrant for ALPR Searches
llm_summary: The Electronic Frontier Foundation has filed a brief urging the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals to hold that police must obtain a warrant before searching the massive databases generated by Automatic License‑Plate Readers (ALPRs). The group argues that these records reveal detailed, long‑term location histories and therefore constitute a protected “search”
